mapper.select: select (select count(*) from qc_iqc where status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')) as iqc, (select count(*) from qc_ipqc where status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')) as ipqc, (select count(*) from qc_oqc where status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')) as oqc, (select count(*) from qc_rqc where status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')) as rqc, (select (select count(*) from qc_iqc where status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')) + (select count(*) from qc_ipqc where status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')) + (select count(*) from qc_oqc where status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')) + (select count(*) from qc_rqc where status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')) ) as total, (select (select count(*) from qc_iqc where status = 'PENDING' and timestampdiff(hour, create_time, now()) > 4) + (select count(*) from qc_ipqc where status = 'PENDING' and timestampdiff(hour, create_time, now()) > 2) + (select count(*) from qc_oqc where status = 'PENDING' and timestampdiff(hour, create_time, now()) > 4) ) as urgent from dual

select * from ( -- IQC待检任务 select 'IQC' as inspectType, i.iqc_id as inspectId, i.iqc_code as inspectCode, i.item_name as itemName, i.item_code as itemCode, i.batch_code as batchCode, i.vendor_name as supplierName, i.inspect_quantity as inspectQuantity, i.status, i.create_time as createTime, timestampdiff(hour, i.create_time, now()) as waitHours, case when timestampdiff(hour, i.create_time, now()) > 8 then 'HIGH' when timestampdiff(hour, i.create_time, now()) > 4 then 'MEDIUM' else 'LOW' end as urgency, '来料检验' as inspectTypeName from qc_iqc i where i.status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')
union all
-- IPQC待检任务 select 'IPQC' as inspectType, p.ipqc_id as inspectId, p.ipqc_code as inspectCode, p.item_name as itemName, p.item_code as itemCode, null as batchCode, p.workorder_code as supplierName, p.inspect_quantity as inspectQuantity, p.status, p.create_time as createTime, timestampdiff(hour, p.create_time, now()) as waitHours, case when timestampdiff(hour, p.create_time, now()) > 4 then 'HIGH' when timestampdiff(hour, p.create_time, now()) > 2 then 'MEDIUM' else 'LOW' end as urgency, concat('过程检验-', case p.inspect_type when 'FIRST' then '首检' when 'PATROL' then '巡检' when 'FINAL' then '完工检' else p.inspect_type end) as inspectTypeName from qc_ipqc p where p.status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING')
union all
-- OQC待检任务 select 'OQC' as inspectType, o.oqc_id as inspectId, o.oqc_code as inspectCode, o.item_name as itemName, o.item_code as itemCode, o.batch_code as batchCode, o.customer_name as supplierName, o.inspect_quantity as inspectQuantity, o.status, o.create_time as createTime, timestampdiff(hour, o.create_time, now()) as waitHours, case when timestampdiff(hour, o.create_time, now()) > 8 then 'HIGH' when timestampdiff(hour, o.create_time, now()) > 4 then 'MEDIUM' else 'LOW' end as urgency, '出货检验' as inspectTypeName from qc_oqc o where o.status in ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING') ) t where 1=1
and t.inspectType = #{inspectType}
order by case t.urgency when 'HIGH' then 1 when 'MEDIUM' then 2 else 3 end, t.waitHours desc
